from bookings import load_bookings, ROWS
from portions import nights_shares, stored_shares


def test_stored_shares():
    shares = stored_shares()
    assert len(shares) == len(ROWS)


def test_shares_of_a_list():
    shares = nights_shares(list(load_bookings()))
    assert abs(sum(shares) - 1.0) < 1e-9
